name: epidural hematoma
definition: Blood in the potential space between the skull and the dura, characteristically biconvex and not crossing sutures.

elements.name: presence
elements.definition: Whether the observation is judged to be present on this examination.

permitted_values.name: present
permitted_values.definition: Observation can be confidently categorized as present based on the data presented to the interpreter.

permitted_values.name: absent
permitted_values.definition: Observation can be confidently categorized as absent based on the data presented to the interpreter.

permitted_values.name: indeterminate
permitted_values.definition: The data presented do not permit categorization as present or absent.

permitted_values.name: unknown
permitted_values.definition: No determination was made, or the examination did not address it.

elements.name: interval change
elements.definition: The relationship of the finding to the same finding on a prior comparable examination.

permitted_values.name: new
permitted_values.definition: Not present on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: unchanged
permitted_values.definition: Without appreciable difference from the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: increased
permitted_values.definition: Larger or more numerous than on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: decreased
permitted_values.definition: Smaller or less numerous than on the prior examination.

permitted_values.name: no prior available
permitted_values.definition: No comparable prior examination was available.

elements.name: amount
elements.definition: How much material is present, on a coarse ordinal scale.

permitted_values.name: trace
permitted_values.definition: Barely detectable.

permitted_values.name: small
permitted_values.definition: Present but of little consequence.

permitted_values.name: moderate
permitted_values.definition: Substantial without dominating the space.

permitted_values.name: large
permitted_values.definition: Filling much of the available space.

elements.name: hemorrhage age
elements.definition: How old intracranial blood is, read from its density or signal on a single study.

permitted_values.name: hyperacute
permitted_values.definition: Within hours. Still largely oxygenated.

permitted_values.name: acute
permitted_values.definition: Roughly the first three days. Deoxyhaemoglobin.

permitted_values.name: early subacute
permitted_values.definition: Roughly days three to seven. Intracellular methaemoglobin.

permitted_values.name: late subacute
permitted_values.definition: Roughly one to four weeks. Extracellular methaemoglobin.

permitted_values.name: chronic
permitted_values.definition: Beyond a month. Haemosiderin and ferritin.

permitted_values.name: indeterminate age
permitted_values.definition: The appearance does not permit dating.

elements.name: collection shape
elements.definition: The outline a collection takes, which reflects the space containing it.

permitted_values.name: biconvex
permitted_values.definition: Lentiform. Bounded by sutures, where the dura is anchored.

permitted_values.name: crescentic
permitted_values.definition: Concave toward the brain. Crosses sutures but not dural reflections.

permitted_values.name: conforming
permitted_values.definition: Filling and taking the shape of the space, such as sulci and cisterns.

permitted_values.name: rounded
permitted_values.definition: Roughly spherical, as within parenchyma.

measurements.name: volume
measurements.definition: The three-dimensional extent of a lesion or collection.
measurements.method: Segmented volume, or the ellipsoid approximation where stated.

measurements.name: attenuation (Hounsfield units)
measurements.definition: The mean CT attenuation of the lesion measured within a region of interest.
measurements.method: Mean value within a region of interest covering at least two thirds of the lesion, on unenhanced images.
